summary: Iter 26 — Frontend regression test of the Reports.jsx refactor (842→122-line orchestrator + 7 files under /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/reports/). Verified all three tabs render, all 5 ledger modals open on double-click, month-nav preserves state across tabs, category/fleet/OT filters and Escorts swap work, hover drilldown tooltip renders. Search-box tint is intact. 1 URL-sync asymmetry bug found (see below); everything else passes.

ui_bugs.issue: URL-sync asymmetry: setTab('attendance') calls `next.delete('tab')`, but `initial` defaults to 'calendar' when the tab param is missing. Effect: clicking the Attendance chip leaves the URL as /admin/reports (no ?tab=), and a page refresh lands the user back on the Calendar tab — Attendance is not reload-sticky. Review-request explicitly says 'switching tabs updates the ?tab= query param', which fails for the Attendance case. Suggested fix: either always call `next.set('tab', t)` for all three tabs (simplest), or flip the default in `initial` to 'attendance' so the delete-on-attendance is consistent with the fallback.

ui_bugs.component: LeaveLedgerModal (not part of this refactor, but triggered from AttendanceTab.jsx)
ui_bugs.issue: React warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key, `leave-rejected`' — fires 4× on modal open. Pre-existing (LeaveLedgerModal.jsx is not a file touched by this refactor) but worth flagging. Non-crashing but risks duplicate/omitted rows.

action_items: Fix URL sync in /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/Reports.jsx `setTab`: make it symmetric with `initial` (either always set ?tab=<t> or change initial default to 'attendance'). Currently clicking Attendance and refreshing silently reverts to Calendar.
(Optional / out-of-scope) Fix duplicate React key `leave-rejected` in LeaveLedgerModal.jsx — key should include the row index or unique leave id.
critical_code_review_comments: AttendanceTab.jsx is now ~600 lines and still comfortably readable — good split. All 4 ledger modals + timeline modal + hover portal live locally and only pass member_id/name outwards, no prop drilling.

Reports.jsx cleanly owns just: year/monthIdx, tab state, athleteLikeKeys fetch, showHours super-admin flag. Correct choice to keep month-nav state at the orchestrator so Attendance and Calendar tabs stay synced (verified: June 2026 label preserved when switching Attendance→Calendar).

DrillDownBubble.jsx is rendered via ReactDOM.createPortal(document.body) from AttendanceTab — correct; keeps positioning immune to the scrollable table container's overflow-hidden. Verified `data-testid=drilldown-tooltip` renders with 17 dates on hover of days-present cell.

The `institution-filter` dropdown legitimately does NOT render on the current dataset because no member row has `r.institution` set (institutionOptions is empty). Not a refactor bug — just data-driven. Escort report table separately shows an Institution column populated from the escort collection.
constants.js / utils.js extraction is a pure move — CATEGORY_FILTERS, SORT_OPTIONS, VALID_TABS, pad2, isoDate, monthWindow are all imported cleanly by the tabs. No duplicate declarations. Good.

MonthNav.jsx is used directly by AttendanceTab (`import MonthNav`) AND passed as a prop to CalendarGridTab. The prop pattern is a little inconsistent — CalendarGridTab could just import MonthNav itself the way AttendanceTab does; passing it as a prop offers no injection benefit here. Non-blocking.
compOffMap fetch (`/leave-balances`) fires once on tab mount and is silent-fail on error — good; the COff column falls back to blank. No console errors observed on that fetch.
Zebra striping + sticky top-0/top-7 header rows verified visually — sub-header stays anchored during vertical scroll.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — 13/14 acceptance criteria passed; URL-sync for Attendance tab is the only failure

rca_of_the_issue: URL-sync asymmetry — Reports.jsx L44-50: `initial = ... : 'calendar'` (Calendar is the fallback when tab param is missing), but `setTab` L46-51: `if (t === 'attendance') next.delete('tab'); else next.set('tab', t);` (Attendance is the tab that clears the param). These two defaults contradict each other. Reproduction: (1) Load /admin/reports (defaults to Calendar, no ?tab). (2) Click [data-testid=tab-attendance] — URL stays /admin/reports. (3) Reload the page — you're back on Calendar, not Attendance. Fix: change `if (t === 'attendance') next.delete('tab')` to `if (t === 'calendar') next.delete('tab')` (or drop the delete branch entirely and always `next.set('tab', t)`), matching the `initial` default.
